title: Nemo staged native application transport v2
description: N15 machine-readable contract. Host discovery is N16 and authority activation is N20.

OpaqueResourceHandle.description: Opaque lease identity only; pixels, canvas, binary data and geometry JSON are forbidden.

ObjectOpaqueId.description: Preserve existing opaque bytes. Numeric indices are not IDs; string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.

segments.description: Matches the accepted renderer count boundary. Shared subset validator does not implement maxItems; N25A tests explicitly check this bound, not runtime admission.

ObjectVectorGeometry.description: Open or closed cubic anchors with ordered relative handles; closure is independent of the anchors.

ObjectVectorFill.description: Explicit null is no fill; absent is refused.

ObjectVectorBody.description: hasRealStroke is authoritative and true exactly when stroke is not null; a fallback colour is never an authored stroke. The owner also requires a positive finite dash length. miterLimit, dashArray, dashOffset and paintOrder keep absent distinct from explicit values.

ObjectWidthStop.description: t must not decrease along the profile.

ObjectVectorPressure.description: Presence is the vector-brush flag. There is no pressure scalar; the visible ribbon is the record geometry and a ribbon has no real stroke.

ObjectParamShape.description: Stored parametric intent of a dynamic rect, ellipse or star; box is the stored frame the anchors were built from.

ObjectParamShapeSet.description: The declared parameters of a parameter set: the same kind the record holds, no box.

strokeSeed.description: G16 option C: the anchor's stamping seed; native produces its dabs from it.

brushTexture.description: G16: the baseline serP brush-texture members of an anchor (preset, group, hidden paint) or a dab (copy flag, group).

ObjectVectorRecord.description: An editable open or closed vector path as the object read returns it.

ObjectVectorCreateTarget.description: A created record names no stroke id: the owner allocates native-stroke:{revision}:{n}.

ObjectVectorCreateRecord.description: The record of a vector create.

placement.description: Optional (absent = front). G15: behind enters under the layer's existing artwork of the frame (baseline drawMode 'behind').

trimEnds.description: Optional (absent = no trim). Baseline trimStrokeEndsMax: cut the new open stroke's head/tail back to its first/last crossing with the layer's paths in the frame when the overshoot is at most this; symmetry copies share the cuts.

keyframe.description: Optional (absent = the Draw/Pen/shape empty key). A held or unexposed target cell becomes a key holding a copy of what it showed (the Labs creators' ensureKeyframe()).

ObjectVectorCreateManyPayload.description: G23: 2 to 32 creates on one layer and frame as one revision and one undo entry (symmetry copies); owner-allocated ids in order.

ObjectVectorReplacePayload.description: Replaces the record with the same full target in place; an authored frame only.

ObjectVectorMaskPayload.description: Original Path mask metadata: selected mode/unset or same-frame layer-shared feather; authored geometry and paint remain unchanged.

trimEnds.description: Optional, create steps only. Baseline trimStrokeEndsMax: the first create is cut against its own cell and every other create (symmetry copies, Labs multi-frame stamps) takes the same cut.

ObjectVectorBatchPayload.description: #2361/#2362: 1..64 ordered create/replace/delete steps on one scene-root layer as one revision and one undo entry; the native owner refuses the whole batch when any step is refused.

ObjectVectorEditPayload.description: Vector create, replace, delete or original Path mask metadata edit. The complete original UTF-8 request envelope is bounded at 65536 bytes, never split or truncated. Other operations and all replies retain their 4096-byte bounds.

ObjectPathFxEntry.description: enabled is absent, true or false; p1..p3 are absent, null or numbers, all kept as sent.

ObjectPathEffectsPayload.description: The COMPLETE new ordered effect stack of one layer. Storage order is evaluation order; an empty stack is an authored empty stack.

ObjectVectorEditResult.description: Compact vector edit receipt: the stroke an owner allocated (create) or the stable target named (replace, delete, mask.edit). Parameter and path-effect edits answer with the compact CommandResult.

ObjectLayerCreateResult.description: Prepared success contract only: outer contentRevision equals expectedRevision + 1. Retained replay proves historical creation identity, not current presence after undo. Public execution remains unavailable until native readers and caller policy are accepted.

ObjectRigId.description: Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.

outline.description: The closed perimeter is at most 16 normalized units; the owner enforces it, the schema cannot.

steps.description: Optional (default 1): move that many history entries as one restore and one new revision. The History panel's jump.
Optional (default 1): move that many history entries as one restore and one new revision. The History panel's jump.

ObjectComponentId.description: Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no NUL; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.

ObjectEditId.description: Authored stable native identity. The owner enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no control character; the string syntax cannot establish provenance or uniqueness.

ObjectLayerSelection.description: Editor layer selection by stable layerUid. The compact receipt does not carry the resulting selection; adapters rebuild it from the post-revision projection.

ObjectClipPayload.description: Detached copied selection carried inline. Bounded structural declaration only: the native owner validates every record and remaps every reference atomically. The 4096-byte request envelope bounds the clip.

activeLayerUid.description: Captured active layer for the original motionArc prefix default; may differ from dragged layerUid. Required by native when a changed edit has stored Arc entries.

ObjectImportSourceId.description: Importer-chosen handle: at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL, not blank, unique per kind inside one batch. maxLength counts code points and is only a coarse character bound; the byte bound is enforced by the Rust and JS validators. The owner maps it to a minted native id and never persists it.

layerUid.description: The source id of a layer in this batch, or the uid of an existing layer.

strokeId.description: The owner mints every stroke id.

hasRealStroke.description: True exactly when stroke is not null.

objectOrder.description: Exact permutation of every new records/raster/text sourceId only. Excludes layers, assets, skips and origin objects. Absence preserves canonical family ordering; receipt order remains records then raster then text. Native owner validates coverage before one publication.

ObjectImportBatchPayload.description: One atomic import batch. Optional assets/raster/text default to empty. Optional nonempty sources uses only the existing native scoped PNG file or bundled/Google font descriptors and requires the captured documentSnapshotId/lifecycleGeneration. No inline bytes, URL, AssetRecord or provider claim is admitted. The original request is fingerprinted before source IO, then the same lifecycle/owner is rechecked before one commit. Retained assets then sources share the asset ID space and receipt order. An unavailable row refuses the whole batch. Complete request remains 4096 bytes; owner/provider admission and saveability are authoritative.

ObjectImportBatchResult.description: Compact receipt: outer contentRevision equals expectedRevision plus one iff applied. Every declared layer, vector/raster/text object, retained asset, source asset and skip is accounted for. Optional assets maps retained assets then sources in declaration order to newly minted assetIds and is omitted by the owner when empty. The serialized result is limited to 3072 bytes.

ObjectPresentationQueryResult.description: Bounded actual successful native presentation discovery. The unchanged complete-envelope limit is 4096 bytes. Rust correlates atRevision with the request and outer contentRevision and requires native-object:<documentId>:<atRevision>; the host supplies the actual context, frame, work and view generation. Historical generator absent; this additive shape is source-derived.

ObjectStableTargetQueryResult.description: Staged immutable common-envelope result: atRevision equals outer contentRevision; snapshot token is native-object:<documentId>:<atRevision>. Complete envelope is limited to 4096 bytes.

ObjectImageMeshQueryResult.description: Source-derived bounded immutable image-mesh view. The complete envelope remains limited to 4096 bytes. Rust validates exact request/presentation/snapshot and full target correlation, held source frame <= presented frame, metadata/count relationships, triangle bounds and cursor progress; JSON Schema shape acceptance alone does not prove them.

ReproductionReportResult.description: Both verified values equal the request tokens; verifiedContentRevision also equals the response envelope contentRevision. The native authority atomically verifies tokens, catalog provenance and exportable journal. Sequence exhaustion rejects.

ReproductionBundle.description: Complete encoded bundle is capped at 3072 bytes before replay. The native decoder additionally validates the pinned catalog identity and entire causal sequence.

ExportMediaBeginPayload.description: Three exclusive shapes: PNG still or sequence (outputSpec, no video), SVG still or sequence (neither outputSpec nor video), video of PNG frames (outputSpec, video optional). A still names its frame (start === end), range.end never precedes range.start, a sequence receipt lists at most 120 frames, absent range members mean the project work area: contract rules the JSON Schema cannot express.

SerializeQueryResult.description: Codec-validated native subset, never legacy v13 packaging. The complete encoded response is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes; oversized reads fail unavailable without truncation.

EvaluateQueryResult.description: Pure immutable snapshot evaluation. The complete encoded response is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes; oversized reads fail unavailable without truncation.

DiagnosticsResult.description: Ordered native terminal attempts, with oldest records omitted as needed to keep the full v2 response within 4096 encoded bytes.

percent.description: Finite native input; the authority applies the retained baseline clamp to 0..100.

ObjectPropertyReadResult.description: Exact authored storage DTO or raw native sample. Native/shared runtime validators additionally correlate owner, revision, snapshot, target, property, frame and cursor; enforce increasing key/curve coordinates and actual native curve endpoints. Missing/null/empty curve distinctions are preserved. Provider result limit3072 and full envelope limit4096 are encoded UTF8 byte bounds, not JSON string lengths. Oversized pages refuse unavailable; no dynamic truncation.

ObjectTextReadResult.description: At most 3072 UTF-8 encoded JSON result bytes; complete envelope at most4096. Chunk offsets count original UTF-8 text bytes, never UTF-16 code units. Pagination never splits a native identity or Unicode scalar.

ObjectFrameRepeatResult.description: Repeat-only immutable native preparation counts, retained after successful commit and on exact replay. Counts describe visited/skipped layers, not whether the document changed; all-component timeline growth can apply with zero cycled layers.

ObjectFrameClipboardCell.description: Bounded structural DTO shell only. Optional rasterItems/textItems carry the cell's raster images and text blocks (entries target+item / target+block, strict native decoding, asset and mesh references stay valid only in the source document; a paste into another document or with an unresolved reference refuses typed). They count toward the same 4MiB data bound. Native strict decoding validates full record/order grammar, offsets, key/record and version/order relationships atomically; no record/order data is dropped. Records/order arrays use nativeDataBytes/32=131072 entries to avoid rejecting native-valid packets above4096 objects; cell/selection counts stay4096 and aggregate native data bytes remain4MiB.

ObjectFrameClipboardPacket.description: Native detached packet; aggregate serialized records plus complete orderElements arrays <=4194304 UTF8 bytes, independently of full correlated envelope. Runtime validators enforce byte accounting.

ObjectFramesClipboardCopyPayload.description: Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

ObjectFramesClipboardCutPayload.description: Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

ObjectFramesClipboardPastePayload.description: Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

ObjectFrameClipboardCopyResult.description: Native retained clipboard result; inner instance/document must match invoking owner; null means no new packet. Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

ObjectFrameClipboardCutResult.description: Native retained clipboard result; inner instance/document must match invoking owner; null means no new packet. Operation-specific complete original UTF8 envelope limit5246976; native serialized record+complete order-array data limit4194304; cell/container reserve1048576 and correlated-header reserve4096. Runtime byte admission, not JSON character length, enforces these limits. Other operations retain4096.

ObjectVectorFillGradient.description: Bounded stored baseline fillGradient. Document-world coordinates and stop/color order retained; item/layer opacity folds once in native style production. Other stop counts remain unavailable.

ObjectFrameBulkMoveResult.description: Ordinary Move actual native destination cells after locks/crop/ripple. Eligible checkpoint publishes true/1 even if bytes unchanged; early no-op false/0/null preserves UI selection. Complete correlated reply is admitted before commit.

ObjectLayerRangePayload.description: Original selector is bounded to4096bytes; exact actual immutable revision and snapshot token must match. Unsupported contexts return Unavailable. No caller-supplied lifecycle echo.

ObjectLayerPlacementPayload.description: Original selector is bounded to4096bytes; exact actual immutable revision and snapshot token must match. Unsupported contexts return Unavailable. No caller-supplied lifecycle echo.

ObjectLayerRowCellsPayload.description: Whole-row cells view of the same query (U31, #2374): frame is the first frame of the page. Bounded to 4096 bytes; exact actual immutable revision and snapshot token must match. Unsupported contexts return Unavailable; a layer without timing is Unavailable, not blank.

ObjectLayerTimingCellPayload.description: Original selector is bounded to4096bytes; exact actual immutable revision and snapshot token must match. Unsupported contexts return Unavailable. No caller-supplied lifecycle echo.

sourceFrameCount.description: T12: the source frame count of the desktop host's decode session bound to this placement and snapshot, as the decoder defines it; null when no session is bound or the count is unknown.

placement.description: T12: the layer's video drawing placement, or null. Remap keys are counted, never listed, so the read stays within 4096 bytes.

cells.description: Runs [startFrame, frameCount, cellKind, sourceFrame, hasContent, manualEdit] tile the page in order; each frame of a run answers the single-cell read identically, an interpolated frame being its own source (sourceFrame is the run start). nextFrame starts the next page, or null when the row is complete.

ObjectLayerTimingCellResult.description: Actual immutable identity and selected source; complete encoded result <=4096bytes or typed Unavailable. A core read is not live host/UI epoch admission or rendering/export acceptance.

contextId.description: Authored context identity; Rust/JS enforce128 UTF8bytes. Only scene-root has an admitted positive copy owner; other contexts return typed unavailable.

layerUid.description: Original opaque authored layer identity; no identifier grammar invented. Native/JS enforce128 UTF8bytes.

stamps.description: Labs multi-frame draw: the other selected frames of the layer the committed shape is also stamped on.

placement.description: drawMode 'behind': the anchor at the bottom of the layer's natural stack, its companion directly above it.

ObjectFillTrace.description: Authored fillSeed/fillSeeds/fillWalls/fillGapPx provenance in the existing native vector record. Empty arrays and an explicit zero remain distinct from absence.

entries.description: One page of the chronological entry list: the done entries oldest first (index below undoDepth), then the redoable ones nearest first. The cursor is undoDepth.

ObjectHistoryReadResult.description: Live current-owner stack depths and one labelled page of entries; atRevision and documentSnapshotId must equal the request and current owner. No retained-snapshot stack semantics.
